name: Warmth - Christmas
source:
After Christmas gatherings, on your way home, you hear a loud noise on the street with a cat's scream. Will you come and see what happens? Will you help her or let her be? 

But it seems like... something else is waiting for you there.

(source: https://plushp.itch.io/warmth-christmas)
translation:
圣诞节聚会结束后，在回家的路上，你听到街上有很大的噪音和猫的尖叫声。你会过来看看会发生什么吗？你会帮助她还是让她这样？

但似乎……还有别的东西在那里等着你。

（来源：https://plushp.itch.io/warmth-christmas）
